Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the authority of medical program directors.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the authority of medical program directors; andamending RCW 18.71.212.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 18.71.212 and 1990 c 269 s 19 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The secretary of the department of health, in conjunction withthe state emergency medical services and trauma care committee, shallevaluate, certify and terminate certification of medical programdirectors, and prescribe minimum standards defining duties andresponsibilities and performance of duties and responsibilities. (2) Nothing in subsection (1) of this section establishes theauthority for a medical program director to independently imposerestrictions on the certification or employment status of a certifiedphysician's trained emergency medical service intermediate life supporttechnician and paramedic, emergency medical technician, or firstresponder if the department of health has not imposed any restrictionson the individual's certification pursuant to an action taken under p. 1 HB 2127chapter 18.130 RCW.
